description: Submits a clip the user already posted on TikTok or YouTube Shorts to a clipping campaign hosted on heistclips, so its views count and earn. Takes the post's link and the campaign (an id or slug from rank_clipping_campaigns where hosted is 'hosted on heistclips'). Checks, from the post's public page: it was posted from an account the user verified (verify_account), it is fresh (posted after the campaign opened and within 48 hours), it is on a platform the campaign pays for, its length, and the caption tags the campaign requires. A post that fails a check is not submitted and the answer says what to fix. Views are then read every 30 minutes. Campaigns on Content Rewards, Ssemble, Vyro or Clipstake are submitted on those sites, not here. Never moves money: payouts are made on heistclips.com.

account.description: The heistclips account code (hc_…) that verified the posting account

campaign.description: The campaign id (h…) or slug of a campaign hosted on heistclips

url.description: The posted clip's link: tiktok.com/@name/video/…, a TikTok short link, or youtube.com/shorts/…

name: submit_clip
